title: 第396章 番外：权臣在现代（二）
slug: 读心后疯批暴君决定洗白
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

宋雲初止住了动作，直愣愣地望着地上那排大字。

这些字是从哪冒出来的？！

会是他人照下来的吗？毕竟这个时代有“高科技”。

思及此，她连忙抬头四处观望。

可四周除了路灯和远处清冷的几道人影之外，再无其他可疑人和光源。

很快，地上那排红字便在她的视野中淡化，直至消失。

地上的男人还在哀嚎着打滚，宋雲初身后的两人也从震惊中回过神来，几乎是下意识拉住了她。

“阿初，不能再打了！”

再打下去，这死变态说不定得住ICU。

虽然他是活该，但她们更担心云初万一被抓去局里蹲……

“刚才地上的字是怎么回事？”宋雲初问二人道，“那是什么技术？”

二人听得一头雾水。

“哪有什么字？”

“刚才地上有八个字。”宋雲初道，“法治社会，禁止行凶。”

“你是出现幻觉了吧？”祝卿安一脸忧愁地望着她。

阿初应该是真生病了，但好在，还有一部分理智的意识在提醒她，别把人往死里打。

“你们没看见？”宋雲初眉头紧锁，“莫非只有我一个人能看见？”

那八个字，是这世界对她的提醒吗？

在这个没有皇权的现代社会，不提倡以强欺弱，她不是宋相，就不能再如前世那样任性。

这里的规矩是生命平等，行凶要付出代价，一旦入了狱，不会有手下来劫狱，她也没有内力杀出去。

这里的武器别说是打死一个她，打死十个百个都够了。

但好在，这里不会有随时想要杀她的人，只要她不犯事，她便可以过得安生。

所以——她得入乡随俗，控制杀意，保持理智。

“都开始胡言乱语了，咱们得快点到医院！”

“这种情况是挂精神科还是看心理医生？不过这么晚了，主任肯定都不在，先挂急诊看看吧，不行的话明天早点再过来。”

宋雲初很快被拽到了医院。

期间她听到了祝卿安和人打电话，“三舅，我到你们那个医院了，精神科这边有你熟悉的同事吗？阿初好像受了点刺激，我把她带来看看……他有空是吧，好勒，谢谢三舅。”

对于接下来的检查，宋雲初很是配合。

她也挺想知道这具身体有没有潜在疾病。

好在检查结果显示，小毛病是有，大毛病没有，某些指标不正常，对当代年轻人来说见怪不怪，毕竟外卖跟零食不好戒。

至于情绪暴躁的原因，大概率是长期熬夜以及工作焦虑引起的，大夫建议多睡觉，少熬夜，避免超负荷工作。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Song Yunchu stopped moving and stared blankly at the row of big characters on the ground.

Where did these words come from?!

Could it have been taken by someone else?After all, there is "high technology" in this era.

Thinking of this, she quickly raised her head and looked around.

But except for street lights and a few cold figures in the distance, there were no other suspicious people or light sources around.

Soon, the row of red letters on the ground faded from her sight until they disappeared.

The man on the ground was still wailing and rolling. The two people behind Song Yunchu also recovered from the shock and almost subconsciously pulled her.

"Achu, we can't fight anymore!"

If the beating continues, this pervert might end up in the ICU.

Although he deserved it, they were more worried about Yun Chu being arrested and sent to the police station...

"What happened to the writing on the ground just now?" Song Yunchu asked the two of them, "What kind of technology is that?"

The two of them were confused.

"Where are the words?"

"There were eight words on the ground just now." Song Yunchu said, "In a society governed by law, murder is prohibited."

"Are you hallucinating?" Zhu Qingan looked at her sadly.

Ah Chu must be really sick, but fortunately, there is still a part of her rational consciousness that reminds her not to beat people to death.

"Didn't you see it?" Song Yunchu frowned, "Am I the only one who can see it?"

Are those eight words the world's reminder to her?

In this modern society without imperial power, bullying of the weak by force is not advocated. If she is not the Prime Minister of Song Dynasty, she can no longer be as willful as in her previous life.

The rules here are that life is equal, and there is a price to pay for committing crimes. Once in prison, no men will come to rob the prison, and she does not have the internal strength to fight her way out.

The weapons here are enough to kill ten of her, let alone one of her.

But fortunately, there won't be anyone here who wants to kill her at any time. As long as she doesn't commit any crime, she can live in peace.

So - she had to do as the Romans did, control her murderous intent, and stay rational.

"They're all starting to talk nonsense. We have to get to the hospital quickly!"

"Should I go to a psychiatrist or a psychiatrist in this case? But it's so late, and the director is definitely not here. Let's go to the emergency room first. If that doesn't work, come back early tomorrow."

Song Yunchu was quickly dragged to the hospital.

During this period, she heard Zhu Qingan's phone call, "Third uncle, I have arrived at your hospital. Are there any colleagues you are familiar with in the psychiatry department? Ah Chu seems to have been a little irritated. I will bring her to have a look... He is free, right? Okay, thank you, third uncle."

Song Yunchu was very cooperative with the next inspection.

She also really wanted to know if there was any underlying disease in this body.

Fortunately, the examination results showed that there were minor problems but not major problems, and some indicators were abnormal. This is not surprising to contemporary young people. After all, it is difficult to stop eating takeaways and snacks.

As for the cause of irritable mood, it is most likely caused by staying up late for a long time and work anxiety. Doctors recommend sleeping more, staying up less late, and avoiding overloaded work.
